about.description: Codebase intelligence for AI and humans: code health scores, auto-generated docs, git analytics, dead code detection, and architectural decisions via MCP.
about.head: 1853a76

name: v0.59.0
body:
## What's Changed
* fix(coverage): explain that a .coverage file builds the per-test map only by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/4320

* fix(coverage): store nothing from a mostly unmapped report unless --allow-partial by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/4323

* feat(tests): a test that swaps a module out does not reach it by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/4338
* feat(tests): a JS or TS test that mocks a module with a closed factory does not reach it by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/4341
* fix(tests): never call a file of only types untested by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/4337
* fix(health): one test-reach definition for the Tests tab and the file page by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/4334

* fix(coverage): name changed files from the indexed checkout in a nested repository by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/4340

* fix(coverage): resolve per-test coverage records with the same path resolver as the aggregate by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/4328
* feat(health): coverage findings carry a prompt to add tests and the rule that silences them by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/4335
* fix(coverage): dedupe the per-test map before its row cap and cut whole tests by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/4331
* docs: readable reference, CI, config, MCP and health docs, with repo-wide test intelligence accuracy by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/4342
* fix(health): label six performance findings that showed raw ids by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/4354
